fields.v: Seal completed units of work as traces -> offload trace bodies under context pressure, keep anchors and synopses -> before context refresh checkpoint frontier and anchors -> after refresh reconstruct frontier via MTG, locate entities via RSG and projection (<=2 MTG hops), validate applicability (aligned and not superseded) -> selectively restore within budget, else re-read or re-run (Algorithm 1)

fields.v:
Model deepseek-v4-flash-0731-high for all, 200K context, no step limit; single run. Values: DeepSWE pass@1 (Python subset) / SWE-EVO Resolved, Fix, Apply / SWE-Milestone Score, Resolved (Table 2); mean wall-clock min per task DeepSWE / SWE-EVO (Table 6). No success criterion stated by the authors for any configuration, so no verdicts.
- Native + Codex CLI v0.144.4 (baseline): 35.4 (32.4) / 47.8, 53.4, 97.8 / 28.6, 7.1; 42.02 / 30.00 min. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Obs. Masking + Codex CLI: 34.5 (38.2) / 65.2, 72.1, 97.8 / 24.4, 9.2; 44.32 / 52.72 min. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- RepoGraph + Codex CLI (Python tasks only): DeepSWE-Py 41.2 / 58.7, 68.8, 97.8 / Python Score 45.2, Resolved 8.3; 34.67 (34 Python tasks) / 34.22 min. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- MemTrace + Codex CLI: 56.6 (67.6) / 69.6, 70.6, 100.0 / 46.4, 16.3; 54.17 / 82.05 min. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Native + mini-swe-agent v2.4.6 (baseline): 48.7 (47.1) / 52.2, 54.1, 95.7 / 34.5, 11.2; 103.77 / 170.97 min. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Obs. Masking + mini-swe-agent: 26.6 (20.6) / 23.9, 33.6, 97.8 / 24.9, 8.2; 120.98 / 170.02 min. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- RepoGraph + mini-swe-agent (Python only): DeepSWE-Py 32.4 / 30.4, 37.9, 97.8 / Python Score 30.8, Resolved 0.0; 70.43 / 203.28 min. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- MemTrace + mini-swe-agent: 66.4 (64.7) / 63.0, 68.7, 93.5 / 48.3, 19.4; 75.30 / 114.03 min. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Ablations (Codex CLI, ablation; SWE-EVO Resolved / DeepSWE pass@1, Table 3): Trace Store Only 65.2 / 32.1 (36/112, one task without score); w/o MTG 65.2 / 34.5; w/o RSG 69.6 / 44.2; full MemTrace 69.6 / 56.6. No criterion stated by the authors

fields.v: Quality: MemTrace best primary metric in every benchmark-harness setting: DeepSWE pass@1 +21.2 (Codex) / +17.7 (mini) points over best baseline; SWE-EVO Resolved +4.4 / +10.8; SWE-Milestone Score +17.8 / +13.8. Partial-progress metrics mixed: Obs. Masking higher Fix Rate than MemTrace under Codex (72.1 vs 70.6); MemTrace lower Apply under mini (93.5 vs 97.8). Baselines sensitive to harness (Obs. Masking +17.4 over Native under Codex, -28.3 under mini on SWE-EVO). Cost (wall-clock, Table 6): MemTrace slower than Native under Codex (DeepSWE 54.17 vs 42.02 min; SWE-EVO 82.05 vs 30.00) but faster under mini-swe-agent (75.30 vs 103.77; 114.03 vs 170.97). No significance tests on performance
